intro: Review what you've learned about protection against regressions.

questions.prompt: Which factors determine how strongly a test protects against regressions?

options.text: Test readability, code style consistency, and the number of mocks used
The programming language, the test framework, and the CI provider
Test coverage, code complexity, and the business importance of the tested behavior
Test execution time, the test author's experience, and the size of the codebase

questions.prompt: Why do tests of complex or business-critical code offer stronger protection against regressions?

options.text: They run faster, so they detect problems more often.
They use fewer dependencies, so they fail less often.
Trivial code is unstable and changes more often.
Complex, business-critical code is more prone to bugs and changes, and failures there have greater impact.
